case.description: Round-064 stuck-pose attempt (sim ~197.5s) with recorded cones/cubes, robot placed flat at recorded x/y/yaw. VERIFIED 2026-08-16: static placement does NOT reproduce the jam - front_clearance reads 0.581 m (not 0.056 m) and NAVIGATE_POSE to seq35 succeeds in 63.8 s with no escape. The recorded 0.056 m front clearance is a lidar-hits-ground artifact of the 67 deg pitch (gazebo_ros_planar_move chassis riding on an obstacle); the jam is a dynamic process, not a static pose. See docs/round064_70pct_escape_repro_report_20260816.md.
